data.text: LAMP GRIDS: AN ORDER OF N THINGS AS N x N LAMPS. ROW = THING, COLUMN = PLACE, ONE LAMP LIT IN EACH ROW AND EACH COLUMN. THE LEVERS MOVE THE COLUMNS
RESET: THE LAMP ROOMS BACK AS NEW, TO PLAY AGAIN
THE LAMPS ARE LIT AS ON THE PLAQUES

S3, THE SYMMETRIC GROUP, OF ORDER 6: 6 OF THE 6 PATTERNS OF 3x3 LAMPS LIGHT. LEVERS (COLUMNS): A (1 2), B (2 3). IT DOES NOT COMMUTE. ALL 6 ORDERS OF 3 THINGS. A THEN B IS NOT B THEN A: TRY BOTH FROM THE START
ROW = THING, COLUMN = PLACE: ONE LAMP LIT IN EACH ROW AND EACH COLUMN. A LEVER SWAPS THE COLUMNS IT IS TIED TO, (1 2 3) TURNS THEM ROUND, 1 TO 2 TO 3 TO 1. LIGHT THE LAMPS AS ON THE PLAQUES
DEBUG: SOLUTION A B (B A LIGHTS ANOTHER PATTERN: THE ORDER MATTERS)
THE LAMPS ARE LIT AS ON THE PLAQUES

D3 = S3, THE TRIANGLE'S TURNS AND FLIPS, OF ORDER 6: 6 OF THE 6 PATTERNS OF 3x3 LAMPS LIGHT. LEVERS (COLUMNS): A (1 2), B (1 2 3). IT DOES NOT COMMUTE. THE SAME 6 PATTERNS AS THE S3 ROOM FROM A SWAP AND A TURN OF ALL THREE
ROW = THING, COLUMN = PLACE: ONE LAMP LIT IN EACH ROW AND EACH COLUMN. A LEVER SWAPS THE COLUMNS IT IS TIED TO, (1 2 3) TURNS THEM ROUND, 1 TO 2 TO 3 TO 1. LIGHT THE LAMPS AS ON THE PLAQUES
DEBUG: SOLUTION A B (B A LIGHTS ANOTHER PATTERN: THE ORDER MATTERS)
THE LAMPS ARE LIT AS ON THE PLAQUES

Z3, THE CYCLIC GROUP, OF ORDER 3: 3 OF THE 6 PATTERNS OF 3x3 LAMPS LIGHT. LEVERS (COLUMNS): A (1 2 3). IT COMMUTES. ONLY 3 OF THE 6 PATTERNS EVER LIGHT: A TURN NEVER SWAPS JUST TWO. THREE PULLS AND IT IS BACK
ROW = THING, COLUMN = PLACE: ONE LAMP LIT IN EACH ROW AND EACH COLUMN. A LEVER SWAPS THE COLUMNS IT IS TIED TO, (1 2 3) TURNS THEM ROUND, 1 TO 2 TO 3 TO 1. LIGHT THE LAMPS AS ON THE PLAQUES
DEBUG: SOLUTION A A IN ANY ORDER
THE LAMPS ARE LIT AS ON THE PLAQUES

S4, THE SYMMETRIC GROUP, OF ORDER 24: 24 OF THE 24 PATTERNS OF 4x4 LAMPS LIGHT. LEVERS (COLUMNS): A (1 2), B (2 3), C (3 4). IT DOES NOT COMMUTE. ALL 24 ORDERS OF 4 THINGS FROM SWAPS OF NEIGHBOURS. THE PLAQUES: REVERSED
ROW = THING, COLUMN = PLACE: ONE LAMP LIT IN EACH ROW AND EACH COLUMN. A LEVER SWAPS THE COLUMNS IT IS TIED TO, (1 2 3) TURNS THEM ROUND, 1 TO 2 TO 3 TO 1. LIGHT THE LAMPS AS ON THE PLAQUES
DEBUG: SOLUTION A B A C B A
THE LAMPS ARE LIT AS ON THE PLAQUES

A4, THE ALTERNATING GROUP, OF ORDER 12: 12 OF THE 24 PATTERNS OF 4x4 LAMPS LIGHT. LEVERS (COLUMNS): A (1 2 3), B (2 3 4). IT DOES NOT COMMUTE. ONLY 12 OF THE 24 PATTERNS LIGHT: TWO SWAPS AT ONCE, AS ON THE PLAQUES, BUT NEVER ONE SWAP (THE ODD PATTERNS)
ROW = THING, COLUMN = PLACE: ONE LAMP LIT IN EACH ROW AND EACH COLUMN. A LEVER SWAPS THE COLUMNS IT IS TIED TO, (1 2 3) TURNS THEM ROUND, 1 TO 2 TO 3 TO 1. LIGHT THE LAMPS AS ON THE PLAQUES
DEBUG: SOLUTION B A (A B LIGHTS ANOTHER PATTERN: THE ORDER MATTERS)
THE LAMPS ARE LIT AS ON THE PLAQUES

D4, THE SQUARE'S TURNS AND FLIPS, OF ORDER 8: 8 OF THE 24 PATTERNS OF 4x4 LAMPS LIGHT. LEVERS (COLUMNS): A (1 2 3 4), B (2 4). IT DOES NOT COMMUTE. THE COLUMNS ARE THE 4 CORNERS OF A SQUARE, CLOCKWISE: A TURNS IT, B FLIPS IT ON THE DIAGONAL 1 3. 8 OF THE 24

DEBUG: SOLUTION A B (B A LIGHTS ANOTHER PATTERN: THE ORDER MATTERS)
THE LAMPS ARE LIT AS ON THE PLAQUES
Z4, THE CYCLIC GROUP, OF ORDER 4: 4 OF THE 24 PATTERNS OF 4x4 LAMPS LIGHT. LEVERS (COLUMNS): A (1 2 3 4). IT COMMUTES. 4 PATTERNS, ONE LEVER. LOOK AT THE Z2XZ2 ROOM NEXT DOOR
ROW = THING, COLUMN = PLACE: ONE LAMP LIT IN EACH ROW AND EACH COLUMN. A LEVER SWAPS THE COLUMNS IT IS TIED TO, (1 2 3) TURNS THEM ROUND, 1 TO 2 TO 3 TO 1. LIGHT THE LAMPS AS ON THE PLAQUES
DEBUG: SOLUTION A A IN ANY ORDER
THE LAMPS ARE LIT AS ON THE PLAQUES

Z2xZ2, THE KLEIN FOUR GROUP, OF ORDER 4: 4 OF THE 24 PATTERNS OF 4x4 LAMPS LIGHT. LEVERS (COLUMNS): A (1 2), B (3 4). IT COMMUTES. 4 PATTERNS TOO, BUT ANOTHER GROUP: EACH LEVER TWICE IS BACK, AND THEIR ORDER NEVER MATTERS

S5, THE SYMMETRIC GROUP, OF ORDER 120: 120 OF THE 120 PATTERNS OF 5x5 LAMPS LIGHT. LEVERS (COLUMNS): A (1 2), B (1 2 3 4 5). IT DOES NOT COMMUTE. ALL 120 ORDERS OF 5 THINGS FROM ONE SWAP AND ONE TURN OF ALL FIVE
ROW = THING, COLUMN = PLACE: ONE LAMP LIT IN EACH ROW AND EACH COLUMN. A LEVER SWAPS THE COLUMNS IT IS TIED TO, (1 2 3) TURNS THEM ROUND, 1 TO 2 TO 3 TO 1. LIGHT THE LAMPS AS ON THE PLAQUES
DEBUG: SOLUTION A B A B B (B B A B A LIGHTS ANOTHER PATTERN: THE ORDER MATTERS)
THE LAMPS ARE LIT AS ON THE PLAQUES

A5, THE ALTERNATING GROUP, OF ORDER 60: 60 OF THE 120 PATTERNS OF 5x5 LAMPS LIGHT. LEVERS (COLUMNS): A (1 2 3), B (3 4 5). IT DOES NOT COMMUTE. 60 OF THE 120: THE EVEN ONES. THE SMALLEST GROUP THAT CANNOT BE BROKEN INTO SMALLER ONES
ROW = THING, COLUMN = PLACE: ONE LAMP LIT IN EACH ROW AND EACH COLUMN. A LEVER SWAPS THE COLUMNS IT IS TIED TO, (1 2 3) TURNS THEM ROUND, 1 TO 2 TO 3 TO 1. LIGHT THE LAMPS AS ON THE PLAQUES
DEBUG: SOLUTION A A B A B (B A B A A LIGHTS ANOTHER PATTERN: THE ORDER MATTERS)
